subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a stable persisted cron, protocol, CLI, hook, UI, and plugin SDK contract, or should yielded-parent waiting remain internal until the final outcome settles?
rationale: The underlying premature-completion bug is established, but exposing a new status across persisted and public interfaces is a product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical consequence of the fix.

options.title: Keep Waiting Internal
options.body: Retain active internal parent state and expose only the eventual terminal cron outcome to public consumers.

options.title: Approve Deferred Contract
options.body: Accept `deferred` as a permanent public value with documented consumer semantics and fresh-install and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Waiting Internal
recommendation.body: Retain active internal parent state and expose only the eventual terminal cron outcome to public consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner most strongly to cron status, task-ledger behavior, and the adjacent Discord progress infrastructure.
